title: Window chain → candidates — input
description: Pure-compute input. Caller supplies per-window labels + (optionally) per-window PC1 / dosage, plus a list of seed window indices. The module returns chain intervals, each tagged with chain_type ∈ {het, hom_separation, mixed}. Adapter is responsible for resolving these from the registry / atlasState.

K.description: K-means K used for this window's labels.

pc1.description: Per-sample PC1 score; required for het-band detection via pc1_midpoint.

dosage.description: Per-sample dosage in [0..2]; enables biological het-detection.

band_quality.description: Optional per-window band-quality score; influences seed picking.

seed_windows.description: Window indices to seed chains from. When omitted, every window is treated as a potential seed (slower).

branches.description: Which branches to run. Drop 'het' for K=2-only chromosomes; drop 'hom_separation' to suppress the homozygous-state path.

cramers_v_threshold.description: Minimum Cramér's V on the L3 contingency between anchor and candidate window for the hom_separation branch.

min_chain_length.description: Reject chains shorter than this many windows.

max_chain_skip.description: Allow this many bad windows in a row before terminating the chain (hysteresis).

het_span_min.description: Minimum het-band PC1 span fraction at the seed for the het branch to engage.

merge_overlap_bp.description: Adjacent/overlapping intervals within this bp distance are merged into one candidate. 0 = strict overlap only.

dedupe_prefer.description: When two chains overlap, prefer the het-based one (typically richer evidence), or the longer one.
